instrument.model: Coherence.h, reproduced exactly, against the product lattice

params.name: cents_tolerance
params.why: the engine's bin width. It is the free parameter of the SCORE, and a ranking change that only appears at one bin width is a property of the bin, not of the model

params.name: index
params.why: the omitted energy is (1-J0(I)^2)^2, so the gap is a strong function of index; M4 tests that the effect tracks it

params.name: max_order
params.why: the engine's own cap, reproduced rather than chosen

params.name: min_index
params.why: the engine's own audibility floor for a modulator

params.name: lattice_order
params.why: the product lattice is truncated at the same Bessel order bound the horizon uses, so the two models are compared over the same reachable set and the difference is the MODEL, not the cutoff

omitted cross-partial energy at I=0.9.name: omitted cross-partial energy at I=0.9
omitted cross-partial energy at I=0.9.why: (1 - J0^2)^2 is a fraction of total lattice energy: 0 to 1

median relative score difference.name: median relative score difference
median relative score difference.why: |L - c| / c over the sampled candidates; the ceiling is the largest value the enumeration actually produced, since a relative difference has no useful a priori bound when c can be small

score difference at I=2.0 minus at I=0.9.name: score difference at I=2.0 minus at I=0.9
score difference at I=2.0 minus at I=0.9.why: a difference of two medians drawn from the same enumerated set, so bounded by that set's range
